in_hebrew.name: Goddart
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Goddart הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'gode' (God) and 'dorht' (journey). The name Goddart symbolizes God's guiding presence throughout one's life journey.

in_greek.long_meaning: Goddart είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English 'gode' (God) and 'dorht' (journey). The name Goddart symbolizes God's guiding presence throughout one's life journey.

in_latin.name: Goddart
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's guidance
